title: Fishing Real Extra Compatibility
description: Adds Fishing Real compatibility for over 25 different mods.
body:
### This datapack adds compatibility between [Fishing Real](https://modrinth.com/mod/fishing-real) and fish from the following mods:
Click Here To See The Current Mod List - **[Nether Depths Upgrade](https://modrinth.com/mod/nether-depths-upgrade):** Blazefish, Bonefish, Eyeball Fish, Fortress Grouper, Glowdine, Lava Pufferfish, Obsidianfish, Searing Cod, Soulsucker & Wither Bonefish - **[Upgrade Aquatic](https://modrinth.com/mod/upgrade-aquatic):** Pike, Lionfish & Perch - **[Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawn-mod):** Angler Fish, Herring & Bluefish - **[L_Ender's Cataclysm](https://modrinth.com/mod/l_enders-cataclysm):** Lionfish - **[Deep Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/deep-aether):** Aerglow Fish - **[Critters And Companions](https://modrinth.com/mod/critters-and-companions):** Koi Fish - **[Sully's Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/sullysmod):** Lanternfish & Piranha - **[Alex's Caves](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves):** Lanternfish, Sea Pig, Tripodfish, Radgill & all Sweetish Fish - **[Alex's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-mobs):** Flying Fish, Blobfish & Cosmic Cod - **[Aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae):** Spinefish - **[BetterEnd](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend):** End Fish **(also [BetterEnd Forge](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend-forge) and [BetterEnd NeoForge](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend-neoforge) works)** - **[Blue Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/blue-skies):** Grittle Flatfish, Municipal Monkfish, Charscale Moki & Horizofin Tunid - **[Mofus Better End / Broken Constellation](https://modrinth.com/mod/mofus-better-end-mofus-broken-constellation):** Axefish - **[Seafarer](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/seafarer):** Horseshoe Crab - **[Miner's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/miners-delight):** Squid & Glow Squid **([Upgrade Aquatic](https://modrinth.com/mod/upgrade-aquatic) is required to bucket them)** - **[Environmental](https://modrinth.com/mod/environmental):** Koi - **[Cultural Delights](https://modrinth.com/mod/cultural-delights):** Squid & Glow Squid **([Upgrade Aquatic](https://modrinth.com/mod/upgrade-aquatic) is required to bucket them)** - **[Crabber's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/crabbers-delight):** Crab - **[Collector's Reap](https://modrinth.com/mod/collectors-reap):** Clam, Urchin, Tiger Prawn & Platinum Bass - **[The Undergarden](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-undergarden):** Gwibling - **[Clutter: Bestiary](https://modrinth.com/mod/clutterbestiary):** Koi - **[Luminous: Overworld](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-luminous-mod):** Trout, Bass & Sunny - **[Wan's Ancient Beasts](https://modrinth.com/mod/wab):** Toxlacanth - **[Youkai's Homecoming](https://modrinth.com/mod/youkaishomecoming):** Lamprey - **[Unusual Fish Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/unusual-fish-mod):** Blind Sailfin, Hatchet Fish, Bark Angelfish, Drooping Gourami, Eyelash, Sailor Barb, Triple Twirl Pleco, Aero Mono, Amber Goby, Beaked Herring, Circus Fish, Copperflame Anthias, Demon Herring, Duality Damselfish, Forkfish, Picklefish, Sneep Snorp, Snowflake & Spindlefish - **[Fins And Tails](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fins-and-tails):** Blu Wee, Pea Wee, Banded Redback Shrimp, Teal Arrowfish, Swamp Mucker, Flatback Sucker, High-Finned Blue, Ornate Bugfish, Wee Wee, Vibra Wee, Night Light Squid, Papa Wee & all Spindly Gem Crabs - **[Rainbow Reef](https://modrinth.com/mod/rainbow-reef):** Goby, Ray, Small Shark, Angelfish, Moorish Idol, Crab, Arrow Crab, Tang, Hogfish, Boxfish, Clownfish, Butterflyfish, Seahorse, Basslet, Pipefish, Parrotfish & Dwarf Angelfish - **[Aquaculture](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquaculture):** Atlantic Cod, Blackfish, Pacific Halibut, Atlantic Halibut, Atlantic Herring, Pink Salmon, Pollock, Rainbow Trout, Bayad, Boulti, Capitaine, Synodontis, Smallmouth Bass, Bluegill, Brown Trout, Carp, Catfish, Gar, Minnow, Muskellunge, Perch, Arapaima, Piranha, Tambaqui, Brown Shrooma, Red Shrooma, Jellyfish, Red Grouper, Tuna, Box Turtle, Arrau Turtle & Starshell Turtle - **[Jellyfishing](https://modrinth.com/mod/jellyfishing):** Jellyfish, Blue Jellyfish, Bubble Jellyfish, Cow Jellyfish, Two-Fisted Jumper & Grease Jellyfish - **[More Jellyfish](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-jellyfish):** Coal Jellyfish, Iron Jellyfish, Gold Jellyfish, Copper Jellyfish, Redstone Jellyfish, Lapis Jellyfish, Emerald Jellyfish, Diamond Jellyfish, Netherite Jellyfish, Smile Jellyfish, Honey Jellyfish & Skellyfish - **[Fintastic](https://modrinth.com/mod/fintastic):** (Coming soon!)
#### This datapack was created with the intention of being used primarily when using [Tide](https://modrinth.com/mod/tide), [Tide Extra Compatibility](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tide-extra-compatibility) and [Fishing Real](https://modrinth.com/mod/fishing-real) together, as many of the listed fish are not fishable by default. ---
